name: Vehicles
summary: World vehicles an actor boards, drives and gets out of (a skiff, a cart) that lend their driver a traversal mode, and personal vehicles a rider cycles through (on foot, bicycle, horse) that change the controller's pace.

assistant.summary: VehicleRegistry (src/game-engine/logic/) owns who is aboard and driving a world vehicle; src/traversal/personal-vehicles.ts owns the cycle key's on foot, bicycle, horse; the engine moves the meshes and applies the pace factors to its own controller.
notes: Bind the cycle to KEY_CYCLE_VEHICLE (KeyB). Switching straight from one kind to the next raises only vehicle_mounted, as Babylon did.
A horse lends ride (personalVehicleModes): give the planner the modes it returns; a bicycle is a pace only.
Pace factors are thousandths of the controller's own walk, run and turn rates.

Without the traversal pack, vehicles still decides who is aboard, who drives and who rides which kind, with its events and pace factors; but no planner takes the modes a vehicle lends, and nothing is saved, because the riding rows and the registry's state live in the traversal save extension that traversal owns. A preset that wants either carries traversal too.
Rideable animals, pets and wild animals (traversal-mounts-pets) are port-later: see docs/traversal-systems.md for the contract note; do not generate them from this pack.
doNot: Let a rider aboard a world vehicle get on a horse (in_vehicle).
Store a vehicle's speed or heading in core: the state that changes is who is aboard, who drives and where it is.
